name: Shadow Trap uses its data-defined secondary radius (#3915)
contract: Shadow Trap 680238 refers to the radius of stun helper 681179 effect 0. SpellRadius 15 gives three yards; the summon AI currently searches five yards around the enemy that activates it.

The activation range remains native. Unit combat reach is included in the existing range check; the outside fixture is seven center yards from the activating enemy, inside the former five-yard search plus combat reach and outside the three-yard search plus combat reach.
A normal trap cast must stun its activating target while leaving the outside enemy unaffected.

steps.label: The close enemy activates the trap
An enemy outside the data-defined radius is not stunned
The outside enemy is not given the damage-over-time effect
